hub.headline: id Tech 4 was id Software's 2004 engine for Doom 3, built around unified dynamic lighting.
hub.next: Point readers to the maintained source ports and record which port builds the original release most faithfully.
hub.what_it_was: A hardware renderer that lit every surface per pixel with dynamic lights and stencil shadows, used for Doom 3 and later games licensed from id.
hub.what_survives: id Software released the source in November 2011 under GPL-3.0 with additional terms that replace the warranty and liability sections. Game assets are not included. dhewm 3 maintains a source port.

name: id Tech 4 (Doom 3)
summary: The Doom 3 engine, released by id Software under GPL-3.0 with additional terms in 2011, maintained today in source ports such as dhewm 3.
